artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is illegible and nonsensical, typical of AI generation. While expected at this resolution, the characters often melt into each other or form non-existent glyphs rather than crisp, albeit small, text.
Slight softness and 'smearing' where individual book spines meet the shelf or each other. Some books appear to fuse slightly with their neighbors or the shelf edge, lacking sharp physical separation.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner of the bookcase base
artifact_observations.reasoning: The perspective lines of the base are mostly consistent, but the very bottom edge seems to flatten out slightly unnaturally against the white background, lacking a distinct shadow or grounding contact point.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or cabinet.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and side panels, ensuring they recede correctly in perspective and don't exhibit geometric melting.
To check for fusion artifacts between individual books and between books and shelves, ensuring distinct topological boundaries.
To assess general image quality, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts like noise or blur.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric consistency of shelf depth and alignment
Lighting and shadow consistency on the white background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. While low-resolution text is normal, AI often generates 'fake' alphabets. Check if the geometry of the books themselves is physically plausible (e.g., do they stand upright without support? Are the spines parallel?). Verify if the perspective distortion at the base is a rendering error or just a lack of shadow.
